entries.zh: 失色，变色（面色骤改）；亦可能指布帛染色褪落〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to lose one's colour, to change countenance / turn pale; (of dyed cloth) to fade
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺，且首字有「电/甩」异文；据西文 perder la color 与「色」字取义，面色改易与染色褪落两解并存。

entries.zh: 买卖亏折本钱（售货或收账中亏蚀；第二字「饴」疑为「蝕」）
entries.en: to lose on a sale (or on collection of payment), to trade at a loss
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺，第二字有「饴/蝕」异文；据西文 perder en la venta（o contrar）取马尼拉商贸语境之「蚀本」义。

entries.zh: 减本钱，亏折本钱、本金减损
entries.en: to lose capital; one's capital diminished
entries.notes: 首字有「减/滅」异文，据西文 perder el caudal（折损资本）取「减」义。

entries.zh: 糟蹋饭食（不加爱惜照管而致食物败坏损失）
entries.en: to waste / spoil food by neglecting it
entries.notes: 汉字「打赖」二字义待考，据西文 perder la comida, no cuidar della 取义。

entries.zh: 赌输，打赌较量落败
entries.en: to lose a wager / be beaten in a contest

entries.zh: 交财仁义绝——谚语：朋友间钱财往来（欠债不还）则仁义恩情断绝
entries.en: proverb: money dealings between friends sever the bond of righteousness — friendship lost over an unpaid debt

entries.zh: 行事，办事〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to conduct an affair; Spanish headword garbled, possibly 'to lose a lawsuit' (uncertain)
entries.notes: 西文词头文理不通（perder el que el pleito）且官话栏残缺，仅据汉字「行事」与闽南语对音释义，存疑。

entries.zh: 折蚀利润甚多（首字「飴」疑为「蝕」）
entries.en: to lose much of one's profit / gain
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺且首字有「飴/蝕」异文；据西文 perder mucho de la ganancia 取商贸「蚀」义。

entries.zh: 消散，消融散失（如盐入水而消散）；引申财物耗散
entries.en: to disperse / scatter and vanish; to dissolve (as salt in water); (of wealth) to be squandered away

entries.zh: 相败，相争落败〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to be defeated in a mutual contest (Spanish headword garbled, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 西文词头转写残泐难通（attrevutura man debados 等不可解），仅「落败」义与汉字「相败」及词尾 e havse a perder 相合，存疑。

entries.zh: 失机，坐失良机、误了事机
entries.en: to miss the critical opportunity / moment; to fail a crucial juncture
entries.notes: 西文 perder la faca 之 faca 一词待考（或为 faca/facha/barca 之讹），据汉字「失机」与闽南语对音释义。

entries.zh: 失接，疏于接待（接客有失礼数）
entries.en: to fail to receive / welcome (a guest); breach of courteous reception

entries.zh: 非体，不成体统、有失体统
entries.en: improper, unbecoming; a breach of decorum

entries.zh: 失礼，待人失礼、有失敬意
entries.en: discourteous; to fail in courtesy / respect

entries.zh: 失信，失信于人（应诺不偿、应酬不周致信用扫地）
entries.en: to lose credit / trust; to break one's word through failure to honor obligations

entries.zh: 负约，背约违约、失约失信
entries.en: to break an agreement / promise; to default on one's word
entries.notes: 西文词头残缺（perder el credito por lo mala… 未尽），汉字「负约」与闽南语对音互证清晰，据以释义。

entries.zh: 输阵，临阵战败、交锋落败
entries.en: to lose the battle / be defeated in war

entries.zh: 毁坏，因不加照管而毁损
entries.en: to ruin / damage (something through neglect)

entries.zh: 毁坏了，毁损净尽（第二字「壁」疑为「壞」异文）
entries.en: ruined / destroyed outright; something lost through neglect
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺且第二字有「壁/壞」异文；据西文 perder algo por no cuidar 与闽南语 hui-hui-liáu 取「毁坏了」义。

entries.zh: 废时，坐误时机（误时而误事，致生意落空）
entries.en: to waste / miss the proper time; to lose the business through a lost opportunity
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺；据西文 perder el negocio por perder la buena ocasion 与「废时」释义。

entries.zh: 失落，遗失
entries.en: (something) to be lost; to go missing
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺；汉字「失落」与闽南语对音互证清晰，据以释义。

entries.zh: 不见，不见了、寻不见（东西失落）
entries.en: (something) to be missing / gone; cannot be found
